# Acme Web

[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/acme/web/ci.yml)](https://github.com/acme/web/actions)
![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@acme/web)

One panel for every Acme device, **on your own machine**.
Nothing leaves it.

Docs live at https://acme.example/docs and the source at https://github.com/acme/web.

## Install

```bash
npx @acme/web init
pnpm add @acme/web
```

## Features

- Sees every device on the network in 4 seconds.
- Works offline.

## Roadmap

- Windows support is coming next month
- Bluetooth pairing
